text: Iniquities prevail: Heb. words or matters of iniquities
waterest it: Or, after thou hadst made it to desire rain
thou settlest: Or, thou causest rain to descend into the furrows thereof | thou makest it soft: Heb. thou dissolvest it
the year with thy goodness: Heb. the year of thy goodness
rejoice on every side: Heb. are girded with joy
